=== FILE: README.md ===
# Wodah Gabriel: Portfolio Website

Five-page personal brand site (Home, Services, Portfolio, About, Contact). Each nav item opens its own page; routing uses the URL hash (#services, #about ...), so it works on any static host with no extra setup.
Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite. Icons and motion are built in (inline SVG, CSS and IntersectionObserver), so there are no extra runtime dependencies.

## Run it
```bash
npm install
npm run dev        # local preview
npm run build      # outputs dist/
```
`scripts/build-local.mjs` is an optional helper for environments where Vite cannot be installed. You can ignore it.

## Project structure
```
index.html                SEO + social meta, fonts
public/                   favicon, og-image.png, apple-touch-icon.png, evidence/ (screenshots)
src/content/              EDIT HERE: all site text and data
  site.ts                 Upwork link, email, WhatsApp, form endpoint, portrait
  services.ts             the four services
  caseStudies.ts          case studies (add more here)
  testimonials.ts         empty = section hidden
  process.ts              the five-stage framework
  stats.ts                key figures strip under the hero (counts up on scroll)
  home.ts                 all copy for the Home page blocks under the hero (platforms, why strategy, services preview, FAQ, final call to action ...)
src/components/           Nav, Hero, Services, CaseStudies, About, Contact, ...
src/components/home/      one component per Home block, assembled in HomePage.tsx (testimonials and the Hire strip hide themselves when empty)
```

## Update content
Edit files in `src/content/`. Anything left empty shows an "Add details" placeholder. Nothing is invented: only confirmed figures appear.

## Add case study screenshots
1. Copy images into `public/evidence/` (PNG or JPG; keep each under ~300 KB for speed).
2. Match the filenames in `src/content/caseStudies.ts` under `evidence` (defaults: `tiktok-01.png` to `tiktok-03.png`, `youtube-01.png`, `youtube-02.png`), or edit the list: `{ src, alt, caption }`.
3. Until a file exists, a "Screenshot coming soon" tile shows. Once present, visitors can click to enlarge (arrow keys and Esc work).

## Complete the YouTube case study
In `caseStudies.ts`, fill `comparison.before` / `comparison.after` (numbers), `channelInfo`, `extraMetrics`, `overview`, `objectives`, `workPerformed`, `approach`, `resultsSummary`, then set `status: "published"` to remove the "Awaiting project data" tag.

## Add a new case study
Copy an object in `caseStudies.ts`, give it a new `id`, set `platform` (`youtube | tiktok | twitch | kick`). Filter chips appear automatically once there are more than three.

## Upwork and WhatsApp links
Edit `links.upwork` and `contact.whatsappLink` in `src/content/site.ts`. Until replaced, the buttons show "Profile link coming soon" instead of a broken link. Contact email and WhatsApp work the same way.

## Contact form configuration
The form validates and is accessible, but **it only counts as working once a backend is connected**.
1. Create a free form endpoint (Formspree, Web3Forms, Basin, or Netlify Forms with a proxy).
2. Paste its URL into `formEndpoint` in `site.ts` (and `formAccessKey` if the service requires one, e.g. Web3Forms).
3. Submit a test inquiry and confirm it arrives in your inbox.

Without an endpoint the form falls back to opening the visitor's email app (if `contact.email` is set); it never shows a false "sent" message.

## Social sharing and SEO
Set `VITE_SITE_URL` (e.g. `https://yourdomain.com`) in `.env` or your host's environment settings, so canonical and share-image URLs are absolute. Replace `public/og-image.png` (1200x630) with your own artwork if you like.

## Deploy
- **Vercel / Netlify**: import the repo; build command `npm run build`, output `dist`. Add `VITE_SITE_URL` in project settings.
- **GitHub Pages**: build locally with `npm run build`, publish `dist/` (for example with the `gh-pages` branch or a Pages workflow). Asset paths are relative, so project sub-paths work.

## Home page blocks
Under the hero the Home page tells a fuller story in this order: key figures, platform expertise, why strategy, featured result, services preview, process preview, who I work with, hire through platforms, FAQ, testimonials (hidden until `src/content/testimonials.ts` has real entries), and a closing call to action. Edit the text in `src/content/home.ts`. The featured result reads its figures from the TikTok case study, and the process steps come from `process.ts`. Links in these blocks jump to the matching service card, the working framework, or the open case study on the other pages.

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>Wodah Gabriel | Digital Marketing &amp; Audience Growth Strategist</title>
    <meta
      name="description"
      content="Wodah Gabriel is an independent digital marketing and audience growth strategist for YouTube, TikTok, Twitch and Kick. Platform-specific promotion, visibility and audience development for creators, streamers and brands."
    />
    <meta name="author" content="Wodah Gabriel" />
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#0B1220" />
    <link rel="canonical" href="%VITE_SITE_URL%/" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="./favicon.svg" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="./apple-touch-icon.png" />

    <!-- Social sharing -->
    <meta property="og:type" content="website" />
    <meta property="og:site_name" content="Wodah Gabriel" />
    <meta property="og:title" content="Wodah Gabriel | Digital Marketing &amp; Audience Growth Strategist" />
    <meta
      property="og:description"
      content="Platform-specific marketing and audience development for YouTube, TikTok, Twitch and Kick creators."
    />
    <meta property="og:url" content="%VITE_SITE_URL%/" />
    <meta property="og:image" content="%VITE_SITE_URL%/og-image.png" />
    <meta property="og:image:width" content="1200" />
    <meta property="og:image:height" content="630" />
    <meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image" />
    <meta name="twitter:title" content="Wodah Gabriel | Digital Marketing &amp; Audience Growth Strategist" />
    <meta
      name="twitter:description"
      content="Platform-specific marketing and audience development for YouTube, TikTok, Twitch and Kick creators."
    />
    <meta name="twitter:image" content="%VITE_SITE_URL%/og-image.png" />

    <script type="application/ld+json">
      {
        "@context": "https://schema.org",
        "@type": "Person",
        "name": "Wodah Gabriel",
        "jobTitle": "Digital Marketing & Audience Growth Strategist",
        "description": "Independent digital marketing specialist focused on YouTube marketing, TikTok growth, Twitch promotion and Kick audience development."
      }
    </script>

    <!-- Fonts: Space Grotesk (headings) + Inter (body) -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
    <link
      href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap"
      rel="stylesheet"
    />
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root"></div>
    <script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx"></script>
  </body>
</html>

=== FILE: scripts/build-local.mjs ===
/**
 * OPTIONAL sandbox helper, not needed for normal use.
 * Builds the site with only esbuild + Tailwind's compiler API, for environments
 * where Vite cannot be installed. On your own machine use `npm run build`.
 *
 * Usage: node scripts/build-local.mjs   (set TOOLS=/path/to/node_modules if needed)
 */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, cpSync, rmSync, readdirSync, statSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { join, resolve, dirname } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const root = resolve(dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname), "..");
const TOOLS = process.env.TOOLS || "/opt/npm-tools/node_modules";
const dist = join(root, "dist");

rmSync(dist, { recursive: true, force: true });
mkdirSync(join(dist, "assets"), { recursive: true });

// 1. Tailwind CSS
const { compile } = await import(pathToFileURL(join(TOOLS, "tailwindcss/dist/lib.mjs")).href);
const twDir = join(TOOLS, "tailwindcss");
const cssSource = readFileSync(join(root, "src/index.css"), "utf8");
const compiler = await compile(cssSource, {
  base: join(root, "src"),
  onDependency() {},
  async loadStylesheet(id, base) {
    let path;
    if (id === "tailwindcss") path = join(twDir, "index.css");
    else if (id.startsWith("tailwindcss/")) path = join(twDir, id.slice("tailwindcss/".length) + (id.endsWith(".css") ? "" : ".css"));
    else path = resolve(base, id);
    return { path, base: dirname(path), content: readFileSync(path, "utf8") };
  },
});

const files = [];
const walk = (dir) => {
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = join(dir, f);
    if (statSync(p).isDirectory()) walk(p);
    else if (/\.(tsx?|html)$/.test(f)) files.push(p);
  }
};
walk(join(root, "src"));
files.push(join(root, "index.html"));
const candidates = new Set();
for (const f of files) for (const t of readFileSync(f, "utf8").split(/[\s"'`]+/)) if (t) candidates.add(t);
writeFileSync(join(dist, "assets/app.css"), compiler.build([...candidates]));

// 2. JS bundle
const esbuild = await import(pathToFileURL(join(TOOLS, "esbuild/lib/main.js")).href);
await esbuild.build({
  entryPoints: [join(root, "src/main.tsx")],
  bundle: true,
  minify: true,
  format: "esm",
  target: "es2020",
  jsx: "automatic",
  outfile: join(dist, "assets/app.js"),
  nodePaths: [TOOLS],
  define: { "import.meta.env.BASE_URL": '"./"', "import.meta.env.DEV": "false", "process.env.NODE_ENV": '"production"' },
  loader: { ".css": "empty" },
  logLevel: "warning",
});

// 3. HTML + public files
const env = existsSync(join(root, ".env")) ? readFileSync(join(root, ".env"), "utf8") : "";
const siteUrl = (env.match(/^VITE_SITE_URL=(.*)$/m)?.[1] || "").trim().replace(/\/$/, "");
let html = readFileSync(join(root, "index.html"), "utf8").replaceAll("%VITE_SITE_URL%", siteUrl);
html = html
  .replace('<script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx"></script>', '<script type="module" src="./assets/app.js"></script>')
  .replace("</head>", '    <link rel="stylesheet" href="./assets/app.css" />\n  </head>');
writeFileSync(join(dist, "index.html"), html);
cpSync(join(root, "public"), dist, { recursive: true });
console.log("Built dist/ (", (readFileSync(join(dist, "assets/app.js")).length / 1024).toFixed(0), "KB JS,",
  (readFileSync(join(dist, "assets/app.css")).length / 1024).toFixed(0), "KB CSS )");
=== END FILE ===
=== FILE: src/App.tsx ===
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Nav, sections } from "./components/Nav";
import { HomePage } from "./components/home/HomePage";
import { Services } from "./components/Services";
import { CaseStudies } from "./components/CaseStudies";
import { About } from "./components/About";
import { Contact } from "./components/Contact";
import { Footer } from "./components/Footer";
import { useRoute } from "./hooks/useRoute";
import { site } from "./content/site";

export default function App() {
  const page = useRoute();
  const first = useRef(true);

  // On each page change: jump to the top, move focus to the content, update the tab title
  useEffect(() => {
    const label = sections.find((s) => s.id === page)?.label;
    document.title = page === "home" || !label ? `${site.name} | ${site.title}` : `${label} | ${site.name}`;
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      return;
    }
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "instant" });
    document.getElementById("main")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, [page]);

  return (
    <>
      <Nav page={page} />
      <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="bg-ground outline-none">
        <div key={page} className="page-enter bg-ground">
          {page === "home" && <HomePage />}
          {page === "services" && <Services />}
          {page === "case-studies" && <CaseStudies />}
          {page === "about" && <About />}
          {page === "contact" && <Contact />}
        </div>
      </main>
      <Footer />
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { caseStudies, caseStudiesIntro } from "../content/caseStudies";
import { services } from "../content/services";
import { testimonials } from "../content/testimonials";
import type { PlatformId } from "../content/types";
import { CaseStudyCard } from "./CaseStudyCard";
import { CaseStudyTile, FeaturedCaseStudy } from "./CaseStudyTile";
import { ChevronLeft, PlatformIcon, platformColor } from "./Icons";
import { Reveal } from "./Reveal";
import { takeCaseTarget } from "./navTarget";

export function CaseStudies() {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<PlatformId | "all">("all");
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // Arrive from a Home link: open that case study straight away
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = takeCaseTarget();
    if (c) setOpenId(c);
  }, []);
  const open = (id: string | null) => {
    setOpenId(id);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "instant" });
  };
  const opened = caseStudies.find((c) => c.id === openId);
  const platforms = useMemo(() => Array.from(new Set(caseStudies.map((c) => c.platform))), []);
  // Filter chips only appear once the portfolio grows beyond a handful of projects
  const showFilter = caseStudies.length > 3 && platforms.length > 1;
  const visible = caseStudies.filter((c) => filter === "all" || c.platform === filter);
  // A case study with confirmed before/after figures and a badge is shown as the featured card
  const featured = visible.find((c) => c.card?.badge && c.comparison.before != null && c.comparison.after != null);
  const rest = visible.filter((c) => c !== featured);

  return (
    <section id="case-studies" className="relative bg-ground py-24 text-ink sm:py-32">
      <div className="glow-top absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[28rem]" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="container-x relative">
        <Reveal className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-12 lg:gap-14">
          <div className="lg:col-span-7">
            <p className="eyebrow mb-5 text-accent-text">03 · Case studies</p>
            <h2 className="text-[2.4rem] font-bold leading-[1.02] tracking-[-0.04em] sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl">{caseStudiesIntro.headline}</h2>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-4 self-end text-[1.05rem] font-medium leading-relaxed text-muted lg:col-span-5">
            {caseStudiesIntro.copy.map((p) => (
              <p key={p}>{p}</p>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Reveal>

        {showFilter && !opened && (
          <div className="mt-10 flex flex-wrap gap-2" role="group" aria-label="Filter case studies by platform">
            {(["all", ...platforms] as const).map((p) => (
              <button
                key={p}
                type="button"
                aria-pressed={filter === p}
                onClick={() => setFilter(p)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium ${
                  filter === p ? "border-accent-strong bg-accent-strong text-white" : "border-line-strong text-ink hover:border-accent hover:bg-accent/10"
                }`}
              >
                {p !== "all" && (
                  <span style={{ color: platformColor[p], ["--icon-cut" as string]: filter === p ? "#3560f2" : "#0b1220" }}>
                    <PlatformIcon id={p} size={14} />
                  </span>
                )}
                {p === "all" ? "All" : services.find((s) => s.id === p)?.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {opened ? (
          <div className="mt-10 sm:mt-14">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => open(null)} className="btn btn-outline mb-8 !min-h-11 !px-4 text-sm">
              <ChevronLeft size={16} /> All case studies
            </button>
            <CaseStudyCard cs={opened} index={caseStudies.indexOf(opened)} />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="mt-12 space-y-6 sm:mt-16">
            {featured && (
              <Reveal>
                <FeaturedCaseStudy cs={featured} onOpen={() => open(featured.id)} />
              </Reveal>
            )}
            {rest.length > 0 && (
              <div className={`grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2 ${rest.length > 2 ? "lg:grid-cols-3" : ""}`}>
                {rest.map((cs) => (
                  <Reveal key={cs.id} className="h-full">
                    <CaseStudyTile cs={cs} onOpen={() => open(cs.id)} />
                  </Reveal>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {testimonials.length > 0 && !opened && (
          <div className="mt-20">
            <p className="eyebrow mb-6 text-accent-text">Client feedback</p>
            <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
              {testimonials.map((t) => (
                <figure key={t.name + t.quote} className="card p-7">
                  <blockquote className="font-display text-xl leading-snug text-ink">“{t.quote}”</blockquote>
                  <figcaption className="mt-5 text-sm text-muted">
                    <span className="font-medium text-ink">{t.name}</span>
                    {t.role ? ` · ${t.role}` : ""}
                  </figcaption>
                </figure>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

=== FILE: src/components/CaseStudyCard.tsx ===
import { useState } from "react";
import type { CaseStudy } from "../content/types";
import { useInView } from "../hooks/useInView";
import { useCountUp } from "../hooks/useCountUp";
import { PlatformIcon, platformColor, Plus } from "./Icons";
import { EvidenceGallery } from "./EvidenceGallery";
import { GrowthChart } from "./GrowthChart";

const fmt = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US");

function Pending({ children = "Details to be added" }: { children?: string }) {
  return <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-line-strong px-4 py-3 text-sm italic text-muted">{children}</p>;
}

/** Large before/after numbers, to-scale bars and an animated growth curve. */
function Comparison({ cs }: { cs: CaseStudy }) {
  const { before, after, afterSuffix = "", metric } = cs.comparison;
  const known = before != null && after != null;
  const [ref, inView] = useInView<HTMLDivElement>(0.3);
  const value = useCountUp(before ?? 0, after ?? 0, known && inView, 2400);
  const pct = known ? Math.max((before! / after!) * 100, 4) : 0;

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-ground/60 p-6 sm:p-9">
      <p className="eyebrow text-muted">Performance comparison · {metric}</p>

      <div className="mt-7 grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <div>
          <p className="eyebrow text-muted">Initial</p>
          {known ? (
            <p className="mt-3 font-display text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-ink/80 sm:text-6xl">{fmt(before!)}</p>
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-line-strong px-3 py-3 text-sm italic text-muted">Add initial {metric.toLowerCase()}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="eyebrow text-accent-text">Final</p>
          {known ? (
            <p className="mt-3 font-display text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-accent-grad sm:text-6xl" aria-label={`${fmt(after!)}${afterSuffix}`}>
              {fmt(value)}
              {value >= after! ? afterSuffix : ""}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-accent/50 px-3 py-3 text-sm italic text-muted">Add final {metric.toLowerCase()}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* to-scale bars */}
      <div className="mt-8 space-y-3" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/8">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-muted/70" style={{ width: known && inView ? `${pct}%` : "0%", transition: "width 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" }} />
        </div>
        <div className="h-3 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/8">
          <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-accent" style={{ width: known && inView ? "100%" : "0%", transition: "width 1.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) .2s" }} />
        </div>
      </div>
      {known && <p className="mt-3 text-[0.72rem] text-muted">Bars drawn to scale from the confirmed figures.</p>}

      {known && (
        <div className="mt-7 border-t border-line pt-6">
          <GrowthChart from={before!} to={after!} suffix={afterSuffix} active={inView} id={`cs-${cs.id}`} />
          <p className="mt-1 text-[0.72rem] text-muted">Illustrative curve. Start and end figures are confirmed.</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {cs.extraMetrics && cs.extraMetrics.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 border-t border-line pt-5">
          {cs.extraMetrics.map((m) => (
            <div key={m.label}>
              <dt className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted">{m.label}</dt>
              <dd className="mt-1 font-display text-lg text-ink">{m.value ?? <span className="text-sm italic text-muted">Add details</span>}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Accordion({ title, children, defaultOpen = false }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode; defaultOpen?: boolean }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);
  const id = `acc-${title.replace(/\s+/g, "-").toLowerCase()}-${Math.abs(title.length * 7919) % 997}`;
  return (
    <div className="border-b border-line">
      <h4>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={id}
          onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
          className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 py-5 text-left font-display text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-ink"
        >
          {title}
          <span
            className={`inline-flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong text-accent-text transition-transform duration-300 ${open ? "rotate-45 border-accent bg-accent/10" : ""}`}
          >
            <Plus size={16} />
          </span>
        </button>
      </h4>
      <div id={id} role="region" aria-label={title} className="expand" data-open={open}>
        <div>
          <div className="pb-6 text-[0.97rem] leading-relaxed text-muted">{children}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function BulletList({ items }: { items: string[] }) {
  if (!items.length) return <Pending />;
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-2">
      {items.map((i) => (
        <li key={i} className="flex gap-3">
          <span className="mt-2.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-accent" aria-hidden="true" />
          {i}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

export function CaseStudyCard({ cs, index }: { cs: CaseStudy; index: number }) {
  return (
    <article className="card p-5 sm:p-9 lg:p-12" aria-labelledby={`cs-${cs.id}`} style={{ ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#0b1220" }}>
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <span className="eyebrow text-muted">Case study {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-ground px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-ink">
              <span style={{ color: platformColor[cs.platform] }}>
                <PlatformIcon id={cs.platform} size={14} />
              </span>
              {cs.category}
            </span>
            {cs.status === "draft" && (
              <span className="rounded-full border border-accent/60 bg-accent/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-accent-text">Awaiting project data</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <h3 id={`cs-${cs.id}`} className="mt-5 text-[2.2rem] font-bold leading-[1.05] tracking-[-0.04em] text-ink sm:text-5xl">
            {cs.title}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-4 text-[1.05rem] text-muted">{cs.summary}</p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="mt-10 grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.35fr_1fr]">
        <Comparison cs={cs} />

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-ground/40 p-6 sm:p-8">
          <p className="eyebrow text-muted">Channel information</p>
          <dl className="mt-4 divide-y divide-line">
            {cs.channelInfo.map((f) => (
              <div key={f.label} className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-4 py-3.5">
                <dt className="text-sm text-muted">{f.label}</dt>
                <dd className="text-right text-sm font-medium text-ink">{f.value ?? <span className="italic text-muted">Add details</span>}</dd>
              </div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-12">
        <p className="eyebrow mb-1 text-muted">Project details</p>
        <div className="border-t border-line">
          <Accordion title="Project overview" defaultOpen={index === 0}>
            {cs.overview ? <p>{cs.overview}</p> : <Pending />}
          </Accordion>
          <Accordion title="Marketing objectives">
            <BulletList items={cs.objectives} />
          </Accordion>
          <Accordion title="Work performed">
            <BulletList items={cs.workPerformed} />
          </Accordion>
          <Accordion title="Marketing approach">
            <BulletList items={cs.approach} />
          </Accordion>
          <Accordion title="Results summary" defaultOpen={index === 0}>
            {cs.resultsSummary ? <p className="text-ink">{cs.resultsSummary}</p> : <Pending />}
          </Accordion>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-12">
        <EvidenceGallery images={cs.evidence} />
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useInView } from "../hooks/useInView";
import { useCountUp } from "../hooks/useCountUp";
import { GrowthChart } from "./GrowthChart";
import type { CaseStudy } from "../content/types";
import { ArrowRight, ImageIcon, PlatformIcon, platformColor } from "./Icons";
import { asset } from "./assets";

/** Portfolio grid card: screenshot, platform, big headline figure, title, short line, button. */
export function CaseStudyTile({ cs, onOpen }: { cs: CaseStudy; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const [broken, setBroken] = useState(false);
  const card = cs.card;
  const image = card?.image ?? cs.evidence[0]?.src;
  const alt = cs.evidence.find((e) => e.src === image)?.alt ?? `${cs.title} screenshot`;

  return (
    <article className="card card-hover group flex h-full flex-col overflow-hidden" aria-labelledby={`tile-${cs.id}`}>
      <div className="relative aspect-[16/10] overflow-hidden bg-ground" style={{ ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#0b1220" }}>
        {image && !broken ? (
          <img
            src={asset(image)}
            alt={alt}
            loading="lazy"
            decoding="async"
            onError={() => setBroken(true)}
            className="h-full w-full object-cover object-top transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.03]"
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center" style={{ color: platformColor[cs.platform] }}>
            <PlatformIcon id={cs.platform} size={44} />
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-1/3 bg-gradient-to-t from-surface to-transparent" aria-hidden="true" />
        {card?.badge && (
          <span className="absolute right-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-accent-strong px-3 py-1.5 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-white shadow-[0_8px_20px_-8px_rgba(61,107,255,0.9)]">
            {card.badge}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-7">
        <p className="eyebrow flex items-center gap-2.5 text-muted" style={{ ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#121c30" }}>
          <span style={{ color: platformColor[cs.platform] }}>
            <PlatformIcon id={cs.platform} size={16} />
          </span>
          {cs.category}
        </p>
        {card?.metric ? (
          <p className="mt-5 font-display text-[2.4rem] font-bold leading-none tracking-tight tabular-nums text-accent-grad sm:text-[2.7rem]">
            {card.metric}
            {card.metricNote && <span className="mt-2 block text-sm font-medium tracking-normal text-muted" style={{ WebkitTextFillColor: "initial" }}>{card.metricNote}</span>}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ImageIcon className="mt-5 text-muted" size={22} />
        )}
        <h3 id={`tile-${cs.id}`} className="mt-7 text-xl font-bold text-ink">
          {cs.title}
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[0.95rem] leading-relaxed text-muted">{card?.blurb ?? cs.summary}</p>
        <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="btn btn-outline mt-7 self-start !min-h-10 !px-4 text-[0.78rem] uppercase tracking-wider">
          View case study <ArrowRight size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

/**
 * Full-width featured card for a case study with confirmed before/after figures:
 * large numbers that count up, plus an animated growth curve. Only the two figures are data.
 */
export function FeaturedCaseStudy({ cs, onOpen }: { cs: CaseStudy; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const { before, after, afterSuffix = "", metric } = cs.comparison;
  const [ref, inView] = useInView<HTMLDivElement>(0.25);
  const value = useCountUp(before ?? 0, after ?? 0, inView, 2400);
  const [broken, setBroken] = useState(false);
  if (before == null || after == null) return null;
  const image = cs.card?.image ?? cs.evidence[0]?.src;
  const alt = cs.evidence.find((e) => e.src === image)?.alt ?? `${cs.title} screenshot`;
  const fmt = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US");

  return (
    <article ref={ref} className="card card-hover group grid overflow-hidden lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.1fr]" aria-labelledby={`feat-${cs.id}`} style={{ ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#121c30" }}>
      <div className="relative min-h-[20rem] overflow-hidden border-b border-line bg-ground lg:border-b-0 lg:border-r">
        {image && !broken ? (
          <img
            src={asset(image)}
            alt={alt}
            decoding="async"
            onError={() => setBroken(true)}
            className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-contain object-center p-3 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.02] sm:p-5"
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center" style={{ color: platformColor[cs.platform] }}>
            <PlatformIcon id={cs.platform} size={56} />
          </div>
        )}
        {cs.card?.badge && (
          <span className="absolute left-4 top-4 rounded-full bg-accent-strong px-3 py-1.5 text-[0.68rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-white shadow-[0_8px_20px_-8px_rgba(61,107,255,0.9)]">
            {cs.card.badge}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col p-7 sm:p-10 lg:p-12">
        <p className="eyebrow flex items-center gap-2.5 text-muted">
          <span style={{ color: platformColor[cs.platform] }}>
            <PlatformIcon id={cs.platform} size={16} />
          </span>
          {cs.category}
        </p>
        <h3 id={`feat-${cs.id}`} className="mt-4 text-3xl font-bold leading-[1.05] tracking-[-0.04em] text-ink sm:text-4xl">
          {cs.title}
        </h3>

        <div className="mt-8 grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div>
            <p className="eyebrow text-muted">Initial {metric.toLowerCase()}</p>
            <p className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-ink/80 sm:text-5xl">{fmt(before)}</p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="eyebrow text-accent-text">Final {metric.toLowerCase()}</p>
            <p className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-accent-grad sm:text-5xl" aria-label={`${fmt(after)}${afterSuffix}`}>
              {fmt(value)}
              {value >= after ? afterSuffix : ""}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-6">
          <GrowthChart from={before} to={after} suffix={afterSuffix} active={inView} id={`feat-${cs.id}`} />
          <p className="mt-1 text-[0.72rem] text-muted">Illustrative curve. Start and end figures are confirmed.</p>
        </div>

        <p className="mt-6 text-[0.98rem] leading-relaxed text-muted">{cs.card?.blurb ?? cs.summary}</p>
        <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="btn btn-primary mt-7 self-start">
          View case study <ArrowRight size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import { isSet, site } from "../content/site";
import { ArrowRight, ArrowUpRight, Mail, WhatsApp } from "./Icons";

function Row({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  href,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  href?: string;
}) {
  const inner = (
    <>
      <span className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-accent/10 text-accent-text">{icon}</span>
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="block text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted">{label}</span>
        <span className="mt-0.5 block truncate text-ink">{value}</span>
      </span>
      {href && <ArrowUpRight size={18} className="shrink-0 text-muted transition-colors group-hover:text-accent-text" />}
    </>
  );
  return href ? (
    <a href={href} className="group flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-line py-4 no-underline" {...(href.startsWith("http") ? { target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer" } : {})}>
      {inner}
    </a>
  ) : (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 border-b border-line py-4 opacity-70">{inner}</div>
  );
}

            </a>
          </div>
        </Reveal>
      </div>
    </section>
  );

=== FILE: src/components/ContactForm.tsx ===
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { isSet, site } from "../content/site";
import { services } from "../content/services";
import { ArrowRight, Check } from "./Icons";
import { clearInquiry, peekInquiry } from "./inquiry";

type Values = {
  name: string;
  business: string;
  email: string;
  platform: string;
  service: string;
  objectives: string;
  additional: string;
};
type Errors = Partial<Record<keyof Values, string>>;
type Status = "idle" | "sending" | "sent" | "mailto" | "error" | "unconfigured";

const empty: Values = { name: "", business: "", email: "", platform: "", service: "", objectives: "", additional: "" };

const platformOptions = [
  ...services.map((s) => ({ value: s.id as string, label: s.label })),
  { value: "multiple", label: "More than one platform" },
  { value: "unsure", label: "Not sure yet" },
];

const serviceOptions = [
  "Channel or account audit",
  "Promotion and visibility",
  "SEO and discoverability",
  "Audience development strategy",
  "Profile or channel optimization",
  "Competitor and niche research",
  "Long-term growth planning",
  "Not sure yet, I'd like advice",
];

const emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;

function validate(v: Values): Errors {
  const e: Errors = {};
  if (v.name.trim().length < 2) e.name = "Please enter your full name.";
  if (v.business.trim().length < 2) e.business = "Please enter your business or channel name.";
  if (!v.email.trim()) e.email = "Please enter your email address.";
  else if (!emailPattern.test(v.email.trim())) e.email = "Please enter a valid email address.";
  if (!v.platform) e.platform = "Please choose a platform.";
  if (!v.service) e.service = "Please choose a service.";
  if (v.objectives.trim().length < 10) e.objectives = "Please describe your objectives (at least a sentence).";
  return e;
}

const order: (keyof Values)[] = ["name", "business", "email", "platform", "service", "objectives", "additional"];

export function ContactForm() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Values>(empty);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Errors>({});
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState<Partial<Record<keyof Values, boolean>>>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>("idle");
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);

  // Pre-select the platform when a service CTA was clicked on the Services page
  useEffect(() => {
    const platform = peekInquiry();
    if (platform) setValues((v) => ({ ...v, platform }));
    return () => clearInquiry();
  }, []);

  const set = (k: keyof Values, val: string) => {
    setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [k]: val }));
    if (touched[k]) setErrors((er) => ({ ...er, [k]: validate({ ...values, [k]: val })[k] }));
  };
  const blur = (k: keyof Values) => {
    setTouched((t) => ({ ...t, [k]: true }));
    setErrors((er) => ({ ...er, [k]: validate(values)[k] }));
  };

  const summary = () =>
    [
      `Name: ${values.name}`,
      `Business / channel: ${values.business}`,
      `Email: ${values.email}`,
      `Platform: ${platformOptions.find((p) => p.value === values.platform)?.label ?? values.platform}`,
      `Service: ${values.service}`,
      "",
      "Project objectives:",
      values.objectives,
      "",
      "Additional information:",
      values.additional || "(none)",
    ].join("\n");

  async function onSubmit(ev: FormEvent) {
    ev.preventDefault();
    const found = validate(values);
    setErrors(found);
    setTouched(Object.fromEntries(order.map((k) => [k, true])));
    const firstBad = order.find((k) => found[k]);
    if (firstBad) {
      setStatus("idle");
      formRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[name="${firstBad}"]`)?.focus();
      return;
    }

    // Honeypot: real visitors leave this empty
    const trap = formRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[name="website"]');
    if (trap?.value) {
      setStatus("sent");
      return;
    }

    if (isSet(site.formEndpoint)) {
      setStatus("sending");
      try {
        const res = await fetch(site.formEndpoint, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            ...values,
            ...(site.formAccessKey ? { access_key: site.formAccessKey } : {}),
            subject: `New project inquiry from ${values.name}`,
            _replyto: values.email,
          }),
        });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(String(res.status));
        setStatus("sent");
        setValues(empty);
        setTouched({});
      } catch {
        setStatus("error");
      }
      return;
    }

    if (isSet(site.contact.email)) {
      const subject = encodeURIComponent(`Project inquiry: ${values.business}`);
      const body = encodeURIComponent(summary());
      window.location.href = `mailto:${site.contact.email}?subject=${subject}&body=${body}`;
      setStatus("mailto");
      return;
    }
    setStatus("unconfigured");
  }

  const field = (k: keyof Values) => ({
    id: `f-${k}`,
    name: k,
    value: values[k],
    "aria-invalid": errors[k] ? (true as const) : undefined,
    "aria-describedby": errors[k] ? `e-${k}` : undefined,
    onBlur: () => blur(k),
  });

  const input =
    "mt-2 block w-full rounded-xl border bg-ground px-4 py-3.5 text-[1rem] text-ink placeholder:text-muted focus:border-accent focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent/40 [color-scheme:dark]";
  const cls = (k: keyof Values) => `${input} ${errors[k] ? "border-error" : "border-line-strong"}`;
  const Err = ({ k }: { k: keyof Values }) =>
    errors[k] ? (
      <p id={`e-${k}`} className="mt-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-error">
        {errors[k]}
      </p>
    ) : null;
  const label = "block text-sm font-semibold text-ink";

  if (status === "sent") {
    return (
      <div role="status" className="card p-8 text-ink sm:p-10">
        <span className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent/15 text-accent-text">
          <Check />
        </span>
        <h3 className="mt-6 text-2xl font-semibold">Thank you, your inquiry has been sent.</h3>
        <p className="mt-3 text-muted">
          I'll review your objectives and reply by email. If you don't hear back soon, check your spam folder or
          contact me directly using the options beside this form.
        </p>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setStatus("idle")} className="btn btn-outline mt-7">
          Send another inquiry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form
      id="inquiry-form"
      ref={formRef}
      onSubmit={onSubmit}
      noValidate
      className="card relative p-6 text-ink sm:p-9 [color-scheme:dark]"
      aria-label="Project inquiry form"
    >
      <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="f-name" className={label}>Full name</label>
          <input {...field("name")} type="text" autoComplete="name" required className={cls("name")} onChange={(e) => set("name", e.target.value)} />
          <Err k="name" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="f-business" className={label}>Business or channel name</label>
          <input {...field("business")} type="text" autoComplete="organization" required className={cls("business")} onChange={(e) => set("business", e.target.value)} />
          <Err k="business" />
        </div>
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="f-email" className={label}>Email address</label>
          <input {...field("email")} type="email" autoComplete="email" inputMode="email" required placeholder="you@example.com" className={cls("email")} onChange={(e) => set("email", e.target.value)} />
          <Err k="email" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="f-platform" className={label}>Platform of interest</label>
          <select {...field("platform")} required className={cls("platform")} onChange={(e) => set("platform", e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">Select a platform</option>
            {platformOptions.map((p) => (
              <option key={p.value} value={p.value}>{p.label}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <Err k="platform" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="f-service" className={label}>Required marketing service</label>
          <select {...field("service")} required className={cls("service")} onChange={(e) => set("service", e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">Select a service</option>
            {serviceOptions.map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <Err k="service" />
        </div>
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="f-objectives" className={label}>Project objectives</label>
          <textarea {...field("objectives")} rows={4} required placeholder="What would you like this project to achieve?" className={cls("objectives")} onChange={(e) => set("objectives", e.target.value)} />
          <Err k="objectives" />
        </div>
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="f-additional" className={label}>
            Additional information <span className="font-normal text-muted">(optional)</span>
          </label>
          <textarea {...field("additional")} rows={3} placeholder="Links to your channel, timelines, or anything else I should know." className={cls("additional")} onChange={(e) => set("additional", e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Honeypot field for basic bot filtering: hidden from people and assistive tech */}
      <div className="absolute -left-[9999px] h-0 w-0 overflow-hidden" aria-hidden="true">
        <label>Leave this field empty<input type="text" name="website" tabIndex={-1} autoComplete="off" /></label>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-7 flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
        <button type="submit" disabled={status === "sending"} className="btn btn-primary sm:min-w-[14rem]">
          {status === "sending" ? "Sending…" : (<>Send Inquiry <ArrowRight size={18} /></>)}
        </button>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted">Your details are used only to reply to your inquiry.</p>
      </div>

      <div aria-live="polite" className="mt-5 empty:hidden">
        {status === "mailto" && (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-line-strong bg-surface-2 p-4 text-sm text-ink">
            Your email app should now open with your message ready to send. If nothing opens, please email{" "}
            <a className="font-semibold text-accent-text underline" href={`mailto:${site.contact.email}`}>{site.contact.email}</a> directly.
          </p>
        )}
        {status === "error" && (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-error/50 bg-error/10 p-4 text-sm font-medium text-error">
            Sorry, your message could not be sent. Please try again, or contact me through one of the direct options.
          </p>
        )}
        {status === "unconfigured" && (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-line-strong bg-surface-2 p-4 text-sm font-medium text-ink">
            This form is not connected yet. Please reach out through Upwork for now.
          </p>
        )}
        {Object.values(errors).some(Boolean) && status === "idle" && (
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-error">Please fix the highlighted fields and try again.</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import type { EvidenceImage } from "../content/types";
import { Expand, ImageIcon } from "./Icons";
import { Lightbox } from "./Lightbox";
import { asset } from "./assets";

function Slot({ img }: { img: EvidenceImage }) {
  // Shown until the real screenshot file is added to /public/evidence
  return (
    <div className="flex aspect-[4/3] flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-line-strong bg-ground/60 p-4 text-center">
      <ImageIcon className="text-muted" size={26} />
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-ink">Screenshot coming soon</p>
      {import.meta.env.DEV && (
        <p className="break-all text-xs text-muted">
          Add file: <code className="text-accent-text">public/{img.src}</code>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function EvidenceGallery({ images }: { images: EvidenceImage[] }) {
  const [missing, setMissing] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [openSrc, setOpenSrc] = useState<string | null>(null);
  if (!images.length) return null;

  const loaded = images.filter((i) => !missing.has(i.src));
  const openIndex = loaded.findIndex((i) => i.src === openSrc);

  return (
    <div>
      <p className="eyebrow mb-4 text-muted">Supporting evidence</p>
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
        {images.map((img) => (
          <figure key={img.src} className="m-0">
            {missing.has(img.src) ? (
              <Slot img={img} />
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setOpenSrc(img.src)}
                className="group relative block aspect-[4/3] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-line bg-ground"
                aria-label={`Enlarge: ${img.caption}`}
              >
                <img
                  src={asset(img.src)}
                  alt={img.alt}
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                  onError={() => setMissing((m) => new Set(m).add(img.src))}
                  className="h-full w-full object-cover object-top transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.03]"
                />
                <span className="absolute inset-0 bg-ground/0 transition-colors group-hover:bg-ground/35" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 inline-flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent-strong text-white opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:opacity-100">
                  <Expand size={16} />
                </span>
              </button>
            )}
            <figcaption className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted">{img.caption}</figcaption>
          </figure>
        ))}
      </div>
      {openIndex >= 0 && (
        <Lightbox
          images={loaded}
          index={openIndex}
          onChange={(i) => setOpenSrc(loaded[i].src)}
          onClose={() => setOpenSrc(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Animated growth curve. The curve is illustrative: only the two end figures are confirmed data,
 * and the chart carries no time axis and no other numbers.
 */
export function GrowthChart({ from, to, suffix = "", active, id = "gc" }: { from: number; to: number; suffix?: string; active: boolean; id?: string }) {
  const curve = "M 24 214 C 90 212, 130 204, 170 186 S 250 118, 300 92 S 372 44, 404 30";
  const area = `${curve} L 404 240 L 24 240 Z`;
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 428 250" className={`h-auto w-full ${active ? "is-in" : ""}`} aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={`${id}-fill`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#3d6bff" stopOpacity=".38" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#3d6bff" stopOpacity="0" />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={`${id}-line`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#3d6bff" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#8ca6ff" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      {[40, 90, 140, 190].map((y) => (
        <line key={y} x1="24" x2="404" y1={y} y2={y} stroke="rgb(255 255 255 / .07)" strokeDasharray="2 6" />
      ))}
      <path d={area} fill={`url(#${id}-fill)`} opacity={active ? 1 : 0} style={{ transition: "opacity 1.2s ease .8s" }} />
      <path d={curve} pathLength={1} fill="none" stroke={`url(#${id}-line)`} strokeWidth="3.5" strokeLinecap="round" className="draw-line" />
      <circle cx="24" cy="214" r="6" fill="#121c30" stroke="#9aa7bd" strokeWidth="2" />
      <g>
        <circle cx="404" cy="30" r="9" fill="#3d6bff" opacity=".35" className="pulse-ring" />
        <circle cx="404" cy="30" r="6" fill="#8ca6ff" />
      </g>
      <text x="24" y="238" fill="#9aa7bd" fontSize="11" fontFamily="Inter, sans-serif">
        {from.toLocaleString("en-US")}
      </text>
      <text x="404" y="14" fill="#8ca6ff" fontSize="11" textAnchor="end" fontFamily="Inter, sans-serif" fontWeight="600">
        {to.toLocaleString("en-US")}
        {suffix}
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

import { useInView } from "../hooks/useInView";
import { useCountUp } from "../hooks/useCountUp";
import { PlatformIcon, platformColor } from "./Icons";
import { GrowthChart } from "./GrowthChart";
import type { PlatformId } from "../content/types";

/**
 * Hero dashboard card. Only the two follower figures are confirmed data
 * (from the TikTok case study); the curve is illustrative and carries no other numbers.
 */
const names: Record<PlatformId, string> = { youtube: "YouTube", tiktok: "TikTok", twitch: "Twitch", kick: "Kick" };

export function GrowthVisual({ from, to, suffix = "" }: { from: number; to: number; suffix?: string }) {
  const [ref, inView] = useInView<HTMLDivElement>(0.3);
  const value = useCountUp(from, to, inView, 2200);
  const platforms: PlatformId[] = ["youtube", "tiktok", "twitch", "kick"];
  const pct = Math.max((from / to) * 100, 4);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className="relative w-full max-w-[35rem]"
      role="img"
      aria-label={`Illustrative growth chart for the confirmed TikTok project: followers rising from ${from.toLocaleString()} to ${to.toLocaleString()}${suffix}.`}
    >
      {/* soft glow */}
      <div className="absolute -inset-8 -z-10 rounded-[2.5rem] bg-accent/20 blur-3xl" aria-hidden="true" />

      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-line-strong bg-surface/85 shadow-[0_40px_90px_-40px_rgba(61,107,255,0.55)] backdrop-blur" style={{ ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#121c30" }}>
        {/* window bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-5 py-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5" aria-hidden="true">
            <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/20" />
            <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/20" />
            <span className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/20" />
          </div>
          <span className="eyebrow text-[0.66rem] text-muted">Audience growth ledger</span>
        </div>

        <div className="px-5 pb-5 pt-6 sm:px-8">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span style={{ color: platformColor.tiktok }}>
              <PlatformIcon id="tiktok" size={16} />

=== FILE: src/components/Lightbox.tsx ===
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import type { EvidenceImage } from "../content/types";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Close } from "./Icons";
import { asset } from "./assets";

/** Accessible full-screen viewer: Esc closes, arrow keys navigate, focus is trapped and restored. */
export function Lightbox({
  images,
  index,
  onChange,
  onClose,
}: {
  images: EvidenceImage[];
  index: number;
  onChange: (i: number) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const closeRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const img = images[index];

  const prev = useCallback(() => onChange((index - 1 + images.length) % images.length), [index, images.length, onChange]);
  const next = useCallback(() => onChange((index + 1) % images.length), [index, images.length, onChange]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const opener = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    closeRef.current?.focus();
    const prevOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = prevOverflow;
      opener?.focus?.();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
      else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") prev();
      else if (e.key === "ArrowRight") next();
      else if (e.key === "Tab" && dialogRef.current) {
        const f = dialogRef.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("button");
        if (!f.length) return;
        const first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
        if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
        else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [onClose, prev, next]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={dialogRef}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Evidence screenshot viewer"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex flex-col bg-ground/95 backdrop-blur-sm"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 text-ink sm:px-8" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <p className="eyebrow text-muted">
          {index + 1} / {images.length}
        </p>
        <button
          ref={closeRef}
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong hover:border-accent hover:text-accent-text"
          aria-label="Close viewer"
        >
          <Close />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="relative flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center justify-center px-4 sm:px-20">
        {images.length > 1 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); prev(); }}
            className="absolute left-2 z-10 inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-surface text-ink hover:text-accent-text sm:left-6"
            aria-label="Previous screenshot"
          >
            <ChevronLeft />
          </button>
        )}
        <img
          src={asset(img.src)}
          alt={img.alt}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="max-h-full max-w-full rounded-lg object-contain shadow-2xl"
        />
        {images.length > 1 && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); next(); }}
            className="absolute right-2 z-10 inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong bg-surface text-ink hover:text-accent-text sm:right-6"
            aria-label="Next screenshot"
          >
            <ChevronRight />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <p className="px-6 py-4 text-center text-sm text-muted" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        {img.caption}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

=== FILE: src/components/Nav.tsx ===
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Logo, Menu, Close, ArrowRight } from "./Icons";
import type { PageId } from "../hooks/useRoute";
import { site } from "../content/site";

export const sections = [
  { id: "home", label: "Home" },
  { id: "services", label: "Services" },
  { id: "case-studies", label: "Portfolio" },
  { id: "about", label: "About" },
  { id: "contact", label: "Contact" },
] as const;

export function Nav({ page }: { page: PageId }) {
  const active = page;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  // Close menu on Escape and lock body scroll while open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    const prev = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      document.body.style.overflow = prev;
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <header className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 border-b border-line bg-ground/70 backdrop-blur-xl supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-ground/55">
      <a
        href="#main"
        onClick={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          document.getElementById("main")?.focus();
        }}
        className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:absolute focus:left-4 focus:top-3 focus:rounded-md focus:bg-accent-strong focus:px-3 focus:py-2 focus:text-white"
      >
        Skip to content
      </a>
      <nav aria-label="Primary" className="container-x flex h-[4.25rem] items-center justify-between">
        <a href="#home" className="flex items-center gap-3 text-ink no-underline" aria-label={`${site.name}, home`}>
          <Logo />
          <span className="font-display text-[1.05rem] font-bold tracking-tight">{site.name}</span>
        </a>

        <ul className="hidden items-center gap-1 lg:flex">
          {sections.map((s) => (
            <li key={s.id}>
              <a
                href={`#${s.id}`}
                aria-current={active === s.id ? "true" : undefined}
                className={`relative rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-[0.92rem] font-medium no-underline transition-all duration-200 ${
                  active === s.id
                    ? "bg-accent/15 text-accent-text shadow-[0_0_24px_-6px_rgb(61_107_255/0.8)]"
                    : "text-muted hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-ink"
                }`}
              >
                {s.label}
              </a>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <a href="#contact" className="btn btn-primary hidden !min-h-11 !px-5 sm:inline-flex">
            Discuss a Project
          </a>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="inline-flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong text-ink lg:hidden"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls="mobile-menu"
            aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
            onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
          >
            {open ? <Close /> : <Menu />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {open && (
        <div id="mobile-menu" className="border-t border-line bg-ground lg:hidden">
          <ul className="container-x flex flex-col py-4">
            {sections.map((s, i) => (
              <li key={s.id} className="border-b border-line last:border-0">
                <a
                  href={`#${s.id}`}
                  onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-between py-4 font-display text-2xl font-bold no-underline ${
                    active === s.id ? "text-accent-text" : "text-ink"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>
                    <span className="mr-3 text-sm font-normal text-muted">0{i + 1}</span>
                    {s.label}
                  </span>
                  <ArrowRight size={18} />
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
            <li className="pt-5">
              <a href="#contact" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="btn btn-primary w-full">
                Discuss a Project
              </a>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

=== FILE: src/components/Reveal.tsx ===
import type { ElementType, ReactNode } from "react";
import { useInView } from "../hooks/useInView";

/** Fades/slides content in once when it scrolls into view. */
export function Reveal({
  children,
  as: Tag = "div",
  delay = 0,
  className = "",
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  as?: ElementType;
  delay?: number;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const [ref, inView] = useInView<HTMLElement>(0.12);
  return (
    <Tag
      ref={ref}
      className={`reveal ${inView ? "is-in" : ""} ${className}`}
      style={delay ? { transitionDelay: `${delay}ms` } : undefined}
    >
      {children}
    </Tag>
  );
}

import { Reveal } from "./Reveal";
import { scrollToId, takeScrollTarget } from "./navTarget";

/**
 * Screenshot frame at the top of a service card; click to see it full size.
 * "contain" shows a whole portrait screenshot on a lit stage, "wide" a whole landscape one,
 * and the default crops from the top. The frame grows to match a taller card beside it.
 */
function ServicePlate({ s }: { s: Service }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  if (!s.image) {
    return (
      <div className="flex aspect-[16/10] w-full items-center justify-center bg-ground" style={{ color: platformColor[s.id], ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#0b1220" }}>
        <PlatformIcon id={s.id} size={44} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  const alt = s.imageAlt ?? `${s.label} screenshot`;
  const whole = s.imageFit === "contain" || s.imageFit === "wide";
  const ratio = s.imageFit === "contain" ? "125%" : "62.5%"; // 4:5 for a whole portrait, 16:10 otherwise
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        aria-label={`Enlarge: ${alt}`}
        className="group relative block w-full flex-1 overflow-hidden bg-ground"
        style={whole ? { backgroundImage: "radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%, rgba(61,107,255,0.30), transparent 62%)" } : undefined}
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="block w-full" style={{ paddingTop: ratio }} />
        <img
          src={asset(s.image)}
          alt={alt}
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
          className={
            whole
              ? "absolute inset-0 h-full w-full rounded-xl object-contain p-5 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.02]"
              : "absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover object-top transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-[1.03]"
          }
        />
        <span className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 inline-flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent-strong text-white opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100 group-focus-visible:opacity-100">
          <Expand size={16} />
        </span>
      </button>
      {s.imageCaption && <p className="px-7 pt-3 text-xs text-muted">{s.imageCaption}</p>}
      {open && <Lightbox images={[{ src: s.image, alt, caption: s.imageCaption ?? alt }]} index={0} onChange={() => {}} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function ServiceCard({ s }: { s: Service }) {
  return (
    <article id={`service-${s.id}`} className="card card-hover flex h-full scroll-mt-24 flex-col overflow-hidden">
      <ServicePlate s={s} />
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-7 sm:p-8">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span
            className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-line-strong bg-ground"
            style={{ color: platformColor[s.id], ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#0b1220" }}
          >
            <PlatformIcon id={s.id} size={22} />
          </span>
          <p className="eyebrow text-muted">Service {s.number}</p>
        </div>
        <h3 className="mt-5 text-[1.7rem] font-bold leading-[1.1] text-ink sm:text-[1.9rem]">{s.name}</h3>
        <p className="mt-3 text-[0.98rem] leading-relaxed text-muted">{s.description}</p>

        <p className="eyebrow mb-3 mt-8 text-accent-text">Core capabilities</p>
        <ul className="grid gap-x-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {s.capabilities.map((c) => (
            <li key={c} className="flex gap-3 border-b border-line py-3 text-[0.93rem] leading-snug text-ink">
              <span className="mt-0.5 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-accent/15 text-accent-text">
                <Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />
              </span>
              {c}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>

        <div className="mt-auto pt-8">
          <a
            href="#contact"
            onClick={() => startInquiry(s.id)}
            className="btn btn-primary"
            aria-label={`Discuss a ${s.label} project`}
          >
            Discuss a {s.label} Project <ArrowRight size={18} />
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

export function Services() {
  // Arrive from a Home link: scroll to the matching service card
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = takeScrollTarget();
    if (t) scrollToId(t);
  }, []);
  return (
    <section id="services" className="relative bg-ground py-24 sm:py-32">
      <div className="glow-top absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[28rem]" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="container-x relative">
        <Reveal className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-12 lg:gap-14">
          <div className="lg:col-span-7">
            <p className="eyebrow mb-5 text-accent-text">02 · Services</p>
            <h2 className="text-[2.4rem] font-bold leading-[1.02] tracking-[-0.04em] text-ink sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl">{servicesIntro.headline}</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="self-end text-[1.05rem] font-medium leading-relaxed text-muted lg:col-span-5">{servicesIntro.copy}</p>
        </Reveal>

        <div className="mt-14 grid gap-6 sm:mt-20 lg:grid-cols-2">
          {services.map((s, i) => (
            <Reveal key={s.id} delay={(i % 2) * 90} className="h-full">
              <ServiceCard s={s} />
            </Reveal>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { stats } from "../content/stats";
import type { Stat } from "../content/stats";
import { useInView } from "../hooks/useInView";
import { useCountUp } from "../hooks/useCountUp";

function Cell({ stat }: { stat: Stat }) {
  const [ref, inView] = useInView<HTMLDivElement>(0.4);
  const value = useCountUp(0, stat.value, inView, 1800);
  const suffix = stat.suffix ?? "";
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="px-1 text-center sm:px-4">
      <p className="font-display text-[1.9rem] font-bold leading-none tracking-tight text-accent tabular-nums sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl">
        <span aria-hidden="true">
          {value.toLocaleString("en-US")}
          {suffix}
        </span>
        <span className="sr-only">
          {stat.value.toLocaleString("en-US")}
          {suffix}
        </span>
      </p>
      <p className="eyebrow mt-3 text-[0.6rem] text-muted sm:text-xs">{stat.label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Key figures strip. Edit the numbers in src/content/stats.ts; an empty list hides it. */
export function StatsStrip() {
  if (!stats.length) return null;
  return (
    <section aria-label="Key figures" className="relative border-b border-line bg-ground">
      <div className="container-x py-12 sm:py-16">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 divide-x divide-line">
          {stats.map((s) => (
            <Cell key={s.label} stat={s} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { HomeSection, SectionHead } from "./HomeSection";

function Item({ q, a, id, defaultOpen }: { q: string; a: string; id: string; defaultOpen?: boolean }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(!!defaultOpen);
  return (
    <div className="border-b border-line">
      <h3>
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={`${id}-panel`}
          id={`${id}-btn`}
          onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
          className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-4 py-5 text-left font-display text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-ink sm:text-xl"
        >
          {q}
          <span
            className={`inline-flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-line-strong text-accent-text transition-transform duration-300 ${open ? "rotate-45 border-accent bg-accent/10" : ""}`}
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <Plus size={16} />
          </span>
        </button>
      </h3>
      <div id={`${id}-panel`} role="region" aria-labelledby={`${id}-btn`} className="expand" data-open={open}>
        <div>
          <p className="max-w-3xl pb-6 text-[1rem] font-medium leading-relaxed text-muted">{a}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { caseStudies } from "../../content/caseStudies";
import { featuredResult } from "../../content/home";
import { useInView } from "../../hooks/useInView";
import { useCountUp } from "../../hooks/useCountUp";
import { ArrowRight, PlatformIcon, platformColor } from "../Icons";
import { GrowthChart } from "../GrowthChart";
import { Reveal } from "../Reveal";
import { HomeSection, PageLink } from "./HomeSection";

const fmt = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString("en-US");

/**
 * 3. Featured result. Pulls the confirmed before/after figures from the case study,
 * so it shows nothing unless real numbers exist. Count-up and chart use only those two figures.
 */
export function FeaturedResult() {
  const cs = caseStudies.find((c) => c.comparison.before != null && c.comparison.after != null);
  const [ref, inView] = useInView<HTMLDivElement>(0.25);
  const before = cs?.comparison.before ?? 0;
  const after = cs?.comparison.after ?? 0;
  const value = useCountUp(before, after, !!cs && inView, 2400);
  if (!cs) return null;
  const suffix = cs.comparison.afterSuffix ?? "";
  const pct = Math.max((before / after) * 100, 4);

  return (
    <HomeSection labelledBy="home-featured">
      <Reveal>
        <div ref={ref} className="card relative overflow-hidden p-7 sm:p-12 lg:p-14" style={{ ["--icon-cut" as string]: "#121c30" }}>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(44rem_26rem_at_88%_0%,rgb(61_107_255/0.28),transparent_65%)]" aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className="relative grid items-center gap-12 lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-16">
            <div>
              <p className="eyebrow flex items-center gap-2.5 text-accent-text">
                <span style={{ color: platformColor[cs.platform] }}>
                  <PlatformIcon id={cs.platform} size={16} />
                </span>
                {featuredResult.eyebrow}
              </p>
              <h2 id="home-featured" className="mt-4 text-[2.2rem] font-bold leading-[1.04] tracking-[-0.04em] text-ink sm:text-5xl">
                {featuredResult.headline}
              </h2>

              <div className="mt-9 grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div>
                  <p className="eyebrow text-muted">Initial {cs.comparison.metric.toLowerCase()}</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 font-display text-[2.6rem] font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-ink/80 sm:text-6xl">{fmt(before)}</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="eyebrow text-accent-text">Final {cs.comparison.metric.toLowerCase()}</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 font-display text-[2.6rem] font-bold tabular-nums tracking-tight text-accent-grad sm:text-6xl" aria-label={`${fmt(after)}${suffix}`}>
                    {fmt(value)}
                    {value >= after ? suffix : ""}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-6 space-y-2" aria-hidden="true">
                <div className="h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/8">
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-muted/70" style={{ width: inView ? `${pct}%` : "0%", transition: "width 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)" }} />
                </div>
                <div className="h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-white/8">
                  <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-accent" style={{ width: inView ? "100%" : "0%", transition: "width 1.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) .2s" }} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-muted">Bars drawn to scale from the confirmed figures.</p>

              <p className="mt-7 max-w-md text-[1.02rem] font-medium leading-relaxed text-muted">{cs.summary}</p>
              <PageLink to="case-studies" openCase={cs.id} className="btn btn-primary mt-8">
                {featuredResult.cta} <ArrowRight size={18} />
              </PageLink>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-line bg-ground/60 p-5 sm:p-7">
              <GrowthChart from={before} to={after} suffix={suffix} active={inView} id="home-feat" />
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted">Illustrative curve. Start and end figures are confirmed.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>
    </HomeSection>
  );
}

import { hireStrip } from "../../content/home";

/**
 * 7. Hire through trusted platforms. Shows only the profile links that are set in site.ts
 * (Upwork now; add `fiverr` there and it appears). With no links it shows nothing.

export function HireStrip() {

=== FILE: src/components/home/HomeSection.tsx ===
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Reveal } from "../Reveal";
import { setNavTarget } from "../navTarget";

/** Section shell: alternating ground / surface bands give the page its rhythm. */
export function HomeSection({ tone = "ground", labelledBy, children }: { tone?: "ground" | "surface"; labelledBy: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={labelledBy} className={`relative ${tone === "surface" ? "border-y border-line bg-surface" : "bg-ground"} py-20 sm:py-28`}>
      <div className="container-x">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Eyebrow + headline (+ optional intro) used at the top of every block. */
export function SectionHead({ id, eyebrow, title, copy }: { id: string; eyebrow: string; title: string; copy?: string }) {
  return (
    <Reveal className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-12 lg:gap-14">
      <div className="lg:col-span-7">
        <p className="eyebrow mb-4 text-accent-text">{eyebrow}</p>
        <h2 id={id} className="text-[2.2rem] font-bold leading-[1.04] tracking-[-0.04em] text-ink sm:text-5xl">
          {title}
        </h2>
      </div>
      {copy && <p className="self-end text-[1.05rem] font-medium leading-relaxed text-muted lg:col-span-5">{copy}</p>}
    </Reveal>
  );
}

/**
 * Link to another page, optionally landing on a spot there (a service card, the framework)
 * or opening a case study. Plain anchor underneath, so it works with keyboard and without JS.
 */
export function PageLink({
  to,
  scrollTo,
  openCase,
  className,
  children,
  ariaLabel,
}: {
  to: "home" | "services" | "case-studies" | "about" | "contact";
  scrollTo?: string;
  openCase?: string;
  className?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  ariaLabel?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <a href={`#${to}`} className={className} aria-label={ariaLabel} onClick={() => setNavTarget({ scrollTo, openCase })}>
      {children}
    </a>
  );
}

      <SectionHead id="home-process" eyebrow={processPreview.eyebrow} title={processIntro.headline} />
      <ol className="relative mt-12 grid gap-4 sm:mt-16 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 lg:gap-0">

        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-[10%] right-[10%] top-[1.65rem] hidden h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-accent/50 to-transparent lg:block" aria-hidden="true" />
        {process.map((step, i) => (
          <li key={step.number} className="relative">
            <Reveal delay={i * 80} className="h-full">
              <div className="flex h-full items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-surface p-5 lg:flex-col lg:items-center lg:gap-4 lg:border-0 lg:bg-transparent lg:p-3 lg:text-center">
                <span className="relative z-10 flex h-[3.3rem] w-[3.3rem] shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-accent/60 bg-ground font-display text-lg font-bold text-accent-text shadow-[0_0_24px_-6px_rgb(61_107_255/0.8)]">
                  {step.number}
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold leading-tight text-ink">{step.title}</h3>
              </div>
            </Reveal>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      <Reveal className="mt-10">
        <PageLink to="about" scrollTo="framework" className="btn btn-outline">
          {processPreview.cta} <ArrowRight size={18} />
        </PageLink>
      </Reveal>
    </HomeSection>
  );
}

=== FILE: src/components/navTarget.ts ===
/**
 * Lets a link on one page land on a specific spot of another page:
 * scroll to an element id, or open a case study. Read once by the destination page.
 */
let scrollTo: string | undefined;
let openCase: string | undefined;

export const setNavTarget = (t: { scrollTo?: string; openCase?: string }) => {
  scrollTo = t.scrollTo;
  openCase = t.openCase;
};
export const takeScrollTarget = () => {
  const v = scrollTo;
  scrollTo = undefined;
  return v;
};
export const takeCaseTarget = () => {
  const v = openCase;
  openCase = undefined;
  return v;
};

/** Scroll to an element shortly after a page mounts (lets layout and reveals settle first). */
export const scrollToId = (id: string) =>
  window.setTimeout(() => document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" }), 200);
