=== FILE: src/content/types.ts ===
export type PlatformId = "youtube" | "tiktok" | "twitch" | "kick";

export interface Service {
  id: PlatformId;
  number: string;
  name: string;
  /** Short label used in forms and chips */
  label: string;
  description: string;
  capabilities: string[];
  /** Optional screenshot for the service card, a path under /public. Without it a drawn platform mock-up is shown. */
  image?: string;
  imageAlt?: string;
  /** "cover" fills the frame and crops (default). "contain" shows the whole portrait image. "wide" shows a whole landscape image. */
  imageFit?: "cover" | "contain" | "wide";
  /** Small credit line shown under the image, e.g. a data source. */
  imageCaption?: string;
}

/** A labelled value. Leave `value` empty and an "add details" placeholder is shown. */
export interface Field {
  label: string;
  value?: string;

  /** Small text after the headline figure, e.g. "followers" */

  /** Short line under the title. Falls back to the case study summary. */

  /** Screenshot on the card, a path under /public. Falls back to the first evidence image. */

}

  objectives: string[];
  workPerformed: string[];
  approach: string[];
  resultsSummary?: string;
  evidence: EvidenceImage[];
  /** How this case study appears as a card in the portfolio grid */
  card?: CardInfo;
}

  quote: string;
  name: string;
  role?: string;
  platform?: PlatformId;
}

export interface ProcessStep {
  number: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
}

=== FILE: src/hooks/useCountUp.ts ===
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const prefersReducedMotion = () =>
  typeof window !== "undefined" &&
  window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

/** Animates from `from` to `to` once `active` is true. Respects reduced-motion. */
export function useCountUp(from: number, to: number, active: boolean, duration = 1800) {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(from);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    if (prefersReducedMotion()) {
      setValue(to);
      return;
    }
    let frame = 0;
    const start = performance.now();
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const t = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 4); // easeOutQuart
      setValue(Math.round(from + (to - from) * eased));
      if (t < 1) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
  }, [active, from, to, duration]);

  return value;
}

=== FILE: src/hooks/useInView.ts ===
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

/** Returns a ref and a boolean that flips to true (once) when the element scrolls into view. */
export function useInView<T extends Element>(threshold = 0.2) {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node) return;
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { threshold, rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px" },
    );
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [threshold]);

  return [ref, inView] as const;
}

=== FILE: src/hooks/useRoute.ts ===
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export const pages = ["home", "services", "case-studies", "about", "contact"] as const;
export type PageId = (typeof pages)[number];

const read = (): PageId | null => {
  const h = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, "");
  if (!h) return "home";
  return (pages as readonly string[]).includes(h) ? (h as PageId) : null;
};

/**
 * Hash-based page routing (#home, #services, #case-studies, #about, #contact).
 * Works on any static host with no server rewrites. Unknown hashes keep the current page.
 */
export function useRoute(): PageId {
  const [page, setPage] = useState<PageId>(() => read() ?? "home");
  useEffect(() => {
    const onHash = () => setPage((prev) => read() ?? prev);
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", onHash);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("hashchange", onHash);
  }, []);
  return page;
}
